The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Russian Menaion Reader plate «12083»: church-month 12 = August, day 8, this folder's feast in all three calendars. The plate is titled «Емилиан»; the Russian Lives keep one Emilian on 8 August, the confessor and bishop of Cyzicus, which is this folder's Russian form «Емилиан Кизический». The day's other plates are the Tolga icon of the Mother of God and «Мирон».
